# Purser

> AI agents pay your suppliers within the limits the CFO sets; above a limit nothing runs until the CFO's passkey (Face ID) signs the exact terms, and one changed cent breaks the signature.
> Purser is the control layer between a company's AI agents and its money on Airwallex and Alta (formerly Metal); everything here ran on test money, in sandboxes and on testnet.

AI agents spend. You sign off. Built for the Airwallex Agentic Banking Hackathon: Starter Kit 11 (x402 Business Agents), entered for the Metal Award and the Visa Award, and for the Founder's Choice Award and the Judges' Choice Award.

## In one minute

- What it is: Claude agents read, check and propose supplier payments; Purser's code enforces the CFO's limits; above a limit the CFO signs a SHA-256 of the exact terms (payee, amount, account, FX quote, fee ceiling) with a passkey before any money call. The payment then goes out through Airwallex, carrying that hash in its own record, and is booked (double-entry, VAT, month close).
- Who it is for: the finance team of a small company that banks with Airwallex and pays suppliers abroad. That buyer is a hypothesis: there are no customers yet, and nothing here has moved real money.
- What is live: Claude's decisions, Airwallex sandbox calls, Alta testnet transactions, Visa Intelligent Commerce via Airwallex Airi (sandbox, test card) and the T:0 sandbox ledger. Every run is dated, with its record: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/runs
- Simulated: the customer, the supplier, the merchants' charges, the settlement (Purser moves the SWIFT transfer to SENT, then PAID, through the sandbox's simulation API) and the second approver (a labelled test passkey).
- Not done yet: real money, real customers, an independent security audit. The roadmap after the hackathon (none of it built yet): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/roadmap-v2.md

Worst case, set by policy: EUR 28,200 on cards and task cards + USD 20 on chain a month. Task cards under a CFO-signed limit: EUR 900 a day. Everything above waits for the CFO. Computed from the policy by exposureOf (src/policy/exposure.ts); the parts are in docs/how-it-works.md.

Why not Airwallex's own approvals? Purser signs the exact terms with the CFO's passkey before the API call, enforces per-agent limits across Airwallex and Alta, and can additionally require Airwallex's approval workflow (IN_APPROVAL handled, src/airwallex/approvals.ts). Live in the sandbox, 10 and 12 Nov: Airwallex held a payout signed by a labelled test passkey IN_APPROVAL until the owner approved it in Airwallex's web app; then PAID, settlement simulated (docs/runs/2026-11-12-airwallex-two-locks-paid.md).

Hands-on on Purser's real engine, a test company of your own on test money: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/try

## Check these first (each with its record)

- The CFO's signed hash inside Airwallex's own transfer record (metadata.approval_sha256, read back from the sandbox): https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/airwallex#awx-hash
- 30 signed payments in a row on 20 Nov, each read back from Airwallex as signed, and 5 one-cent changes refused before any create (sandbox; PAID by the sandbox's simulation): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-20-airwallex-soak.md
- The same create sent again under one request_id: Airwallex refused all 9 repeats and kept one object per request_id; two of its answers were codes Purser did not yet read as duplicates, fixed the same day (sandbox, 20 Nov): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-20-airwallex-replay.md
- Agents' mandates on Alta testnet refusing payments on chain, each refusal a transaction of its own that moved 0.00: over the cap, another payee, over the budget (19 Nov): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-19-alta-series.md; over the payment count, revoked, not yet started, expired (20 Nov): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-20-alta-refusals.md
- Every Airwallex sandbox call from the committed run records, each with what came back: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/airwallex/calls

## For judges: watch, try, verify

1. Watch the demo (3:15): https://youtu.be/gEUm8RlhZac
2. Try it (2 minutes, test money): https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/try: the agent pays EUR 120.00 alone; you sign EUR 1,850.00 with a passkey; the same payment with one cent changed is refused; download its proof file and check it on https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/verify
3. Verify in 3 commands, offline, no keys (Node.js 22.13+, after git clone https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents): `npm ci`, `npm run judge -- --check` (every page built from the main run's record), `npm run verify-approval` (the owner's real passkey approval of 7 November, checked with Node's crypto)
4. All the evidence on one page: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/proof#evidence (the evidence wall below, as tiles), every live run on https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/runs

- USD 0.0048 Claude cost per /try journey (sandbox; list price; USD 0.2811 for 58): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/tree/main/docs/runs

## Connect an AI (MCP): read and propose only

- Connect any AI: Purser Cloud is a remote MCP server at https://purser-try.max-31b.workers.dev/mcp; the demo company's public, read-only token is purser-demo-read-only. Your AI reads and can propose a payment; it can never approve or pay: docs/connect-claude.md; every tool, its annotations, the error codes and the safety model: docs/mcp.md
- No MCP tool approves, pays, changes a limit or writes to the books: every payment needs the CFO's passkey in Purser Cloud. The demo company is made-up data from a simulated month, no real money.
- Connect Purser to anything: every way in or out, each with its honest label (live, sandbox, testnet, format export, built and not tested live, planned), a quickstart and its guide: the payment rails, AI over MCP, the REST API and its OpenAPI, signed webhooks, no-code tools, accounting, Peppol, ISO 20022, Slack and Teams, the full export: https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/integrations/README.md (the same list as JSON: GET /v1/connections on Purser Cloud)

## Security posture: self-assessments, not audits

- No independent audit or penetration test has been done. What exists is written by the project itself: an OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 Level 2 self-assessment (190 pass, 22 fail of the 212 requirements that apply, 19 Nov; written with Claude, not verified by anyone independent): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/security/asvs-l2.md
- The threat model, each control with its evidence, and the risks still open (accepted risks included): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/security.md
- OpenSSF Best Practices: Silver, from the project's own answers to the programme's criteria (project 16923, as of 19 Nov; the live status is on the project page): https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/16923
- Security and trust: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/security (each control with its proof, and what is not in place yet; sandbox and testnet only)

## Product pages

- [/try](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/try): a test company of your own; Claude reads an invoice, the Checker agent's tool calls are shown with its model, timing and cost, you sign the exact terms with a passkey, then one cent more is refused
- [/airwallex](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/airwallex): cards per agent with the CFO policy as Airwallex's controls, read back; Airwallex's own declines; SWIFT payouts carrying the signed hash; FX for the shortfall only. Its API coverage, each endpoint LIVE (a committed record holds a call), TESTED ONLY or CODE ONLY: https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/evidence/airwallex-api-coverage.md
- [/alta](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/alta): Alta (formerly Metal) testnet: a mandate on chain per agent; the main run's 86 payments, each its own transaction; purchase #24 refused on chain after we switched off our own check once to test the chain (/metal answers 301 to it)
- [/visa](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/visa): Visa Intelligent Commerce through Airwallex's Airi, sandbox and a test card; Visa is named for the rail only, no endorsement implied
- [/claude](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/claude): the Claude agents, their evals and their cost; routine payments are code. The payables agents' evals re-run on 20 Nov on that day's code with Claude Haiku, Sonnet and Opus: all 186 case runs right, none fooled, no unsafe outcome after code, USD 1.70 in all (the same cases as 12 Nov, so not held out): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-20-claude-ap-evals.md
- [/books](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/books): a month of a test company's 20 supplier invoices, each read and coded by Claude, every choice checked by code, the books balanced
- [/t0](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/t0): T:0's sandbox as Purser's outside general ledger; the main run's 95 journal entries posted and read back, every account to the cent
- Docs and API: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/docs (the agent API's tools as the code defines them, the Purser Cloud REST API's reference, x402 and the Airwallex webhooks, and how to run it offline; sandbox and testnet only)
- Status: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/status (the site's own /health in plain words, where no live run in progress is the normal state, and the five latest live runs; sandbox and testnet only)

- [The Airwallex-only run](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-07-awx-1.md): Airwallex's own card controls declined an agent's EUR 45.00 purchase (charge simulated via the sandbox) over its EUR 30.00 limit (LIMIT_EXCEEDED, card transaction 01a1b5e8-6dc2-7000-95bf-c8fc5e6e2f38; 7 November; all seven checks passed)
- [Visa, the first Airi run](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-07-vic-1.md): 7 November; Airwallex sandbox, test card; a scripted run, no Claude call; one person played both the CFO and the cardholder: above Purser's limit PaymentIntent int_sgpvzc9hjhnxvxc26ie succeeded only after the CFO's Face ID; a disallowed merchant was refused by Purser before Airi was asked; all five checks passed
- [Visa, the latest of the 4 runs](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-14-vic-5.md): 14 November; the rail chosen by Claude Haiku; EUR 45.00 paid only after Face ID, the terms hash read back from Airi's mandate and Airwallex's PaymentIntent; that purchase's own credential, tried for another amount and a second time, refused by Purser (PURSER_CREDENTIAL_AMOUNT_MISMATCH, PURSER_CREDENTIAL_ALREADY_USED) before any call
- [The finance case](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/finance-value.md): for a CFO: the job step by step, measured cost and time per invoice, the controls mapped, the books, what is not proven yet
- After the kit: Airwallex connected accounts live in the sandbox (10 Nov: account acct_SC-QD89fOneAeqaRFgOymw ACTIVE; EUR 5.00 payout a9460dba-f31b-4111-be58-6d9a9e71adb1 with Purser's EUR 0.05 fee accepted by Airwallex, settlement simulated); the SME invoice inbox's code is in this repository (src/ap, src/ledger, src/vault, src/erp, src/payouts, cloud/), tested offline on fakes of Airwallex and Claude; it ran once end to end in the sandbox on 10 Nov for three test companies (1 payout PAID, 3 refused by Airwallex for a missing business registration number; the PAID one EUR 4.84, 593c340b-1752-4537-9ef2-0eb3558897cc, Purser's fee EUR 0.02, as /runs and /airwallex show it); purser Cloud runs publicly as a test preview at purser-try.max-31b.workers.dev/try: test companies, test money on a simulated bank, and its console's Try as guest opens a demo company read-only; the product's own console deployment is another matter: that hosted preview exists but is private (behind an access key), no customer uses it, and it is not ready for real money: docs/after-the-kit.md, docs/runs/2026-11-10-platform-e2e.md

## Pilots and partnerships

Pilots, partnerships and questions: max.geurtsen@outlook.com. Purser has no customers yet and runs on test money only.

## For agents

- Proof as JSON: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/proof.json. A signed receipt you can check offline: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/receipt-sample.json
- To check a receipt: write the terms as canonical JSON (keys sorted, money as decimal strings); its SHA-256 equals terms_sha256; that hash is the WebAuthn challenge in clientDataJSON; the ES256 signature verifies with public_key. In a clone: npm run verify-receipt -- docs/runs/2026-11-07-awx-1/receipt-P-0002.json
- The sample is the owner's own passkey approval of 7 November (live, Airwallex sandbox, test money; Face ID, as stated by the owner): the receipt does not prove who holds the key, or that it was Face ID (no attestation is checked).
- An outside agent can ask for a company card and pay within limits over MCP (npm run mcp, docs/agent-api.md). Only a person's passkey can approve.
- skills/purser-spend/SKILL.md: how an outside agent should use the agent API
